**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The only MFN-style provision in the Agreement is § 7.6 (p0031), and it runs in **our** favour: Brightline warrants that Fees charged to Northwind will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.

I checked the fees section (§ 7), order forms (§ 4) and general (§ 30) in full, and searched for "most favoured", "no less favourable", "favourable/favorable", "best terms", third-party matching and exclusivity/preferred-provider language. Nothing obliges Northwind to extend best terms to the Vendor or to match third-party offers. That satisfies the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer; a Vendor-granted MFN is welcome), so § 7.6 stays as drafted.
